source_prior: Gaussian six-feature posterior after independent source observations, zero mean and isotropic precision 0.25
assay: four target responses on each of 30 nodes, costing 120 per policy
allocation: rank all nodes by scratch-minus-source Gaussian log marginal evidence from the four-response assay; ties break by node index; spend ten more responses on each of the top eight nodes, costing 80; maximum 14 responses at any node
uniform_control_allocation: same four-response assay, then 80 responses in quotient/remainder node-index order, for six or seven responses per node
soft_mixture: full-acquired-data Bayesian model average of source-warm and scratch posterior means with fixed prior scratch/change probability 0.1
score: independent existing 1024-point target test-design MSE by changed and unchanged node; labels and latent coefficients evaluator-only
primary_gate: For each source-size and change-type stratum, adaptive soft-mixture changed-node mean MSE <=0.8 times uniform soft-mixture and <=1.05 times adaptive scratch. Adaptive soft-mixture unchanged-node mean MSE <=1.05 times uniform soft-mixture and <=1.05 times adaptive source-warm. Report exact allocations, nomination recall, per-seed means and paired uncertainty. Passing is a local matched-family capability result only and does not authorize a neural architecture or foundation-model claim.
custody: Count source acquisitions separately. Every policy has exactly 200 target responses; report both arm-level and unique generated observations when controls share prefixes. Store source and action receipts, source revision, hashes, exact counts, deterministic replay, and zero closed-model calls.
forbidden: No changed labels, latent coefficients, target test responses, private outcomes, Azure, or other closed-source model outputs enter allocation or fitting. Do not adjust top-eight size, mixture prior, gate, or seeds after generation.
